God told Hosea to marry Gomer as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness. What does this show about God's love for his people?
The children's names showed broken relationship. What does sin do to our relationship with God?
"Children of the living God" shall be said where they were called "Not my people." How does God restore us?
"I will allure her... and speak tenderly to her." How does God draw you back?
"I will betroth you to me in righteousness and in justice, in steadfast love and in mercy." What does God's committed love mean to you?
"I will say to Not My People, 'You are my people'; and he shall say, 'You are my God.'" How does this show grace?
"Go again, love a woman who is loved by another... even as the Lord loves the children of Israel." How does God keep loving the unfaithful?
Afterward they shall return and seek the Lord. What does returning to God look like?
"There is no faithfulness or steadfast love, and no knowledge of God in the land." What happens when a society forgets God?
"My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge." How can you grow in knowing God?
Their deeds did not permit them to return to God. How can habits keep us from God?
God waits until they acknowledge their guilt and seek his face. What does seeking God's face look like?
"Come, let us return to the Lord; for he has torn us, that he may heal us." How has God healed you?
"Let us press on to know the Lord." How can you press on to know God?
"I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings." What does God want most?
Ephraim was like a cake not turned, and strangers devoured his strength without his knowing. How can we drift without noticing?
"They do not cry to me from the heart." How can your prayers come from the heart?
"They sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind." What does this teach about consequences?
"Israel has forgotten his Maker." How can we forget God amid busy lives?
Israel had loved a prostitute's wages. What lures our love away from God?
"They have not listened to him." What makes it hard to listen to God?
Israel was a luxuriant vine, but their heart was false. How can prosperity make the heart false?
"Sow for yourselves righteousness; reap steadfast love; break up your fallow ground, for it is the time to seek the Lord." What would you sow?
"When Israel was a child, I loved him... I led them with cords of kindness, with the bands of love." How has God led you with kindness?
"How can I give you up?... My compassion grows warm and tender." What does this show about God's heart?
Jacob wrestled with God and wept and sought his favour. What are you wrestling with God about?
"Return to your God, hold fast to love and justice, and wait continually for your God." Which do you need most?
God fed them, and they became proud and forgot him. How can blessing lead to forgetting?
"O Death, where are your plagues? O Sheol, where is your sting?" How does Paul use this in 1 Corinthians 15?
"Return, O Israel, to the Lord your God... Take with you words and return to the Lord." What words would you bring to God?
"I will heal their apostasy; I will love them freely." What does God's free love mean to you?
"The ways of the Lord are right, and the upright walk in them." How do you walk in God's ways?
